svg.title: I-ITSM | Response DTOs and view composition

g.text: I-ITSM | Response DTOs and view composition
IncidentView includes reporter/technician views, classification, calculated priority and reasons,
all lifecycle timestamps, SLA deadlines/violations and resolution/verification details.
ViewMapper performs entity-to-view mapping. Password hashes are excluded from UserView.
Solid hollow triangle: inheritance | Dashed hollow triangle: interface realization
Filled diamond: composition | Hollow diamond: shared aggregation
Arrow: stored association | Dashed arrow: dependency
Source snapshot: 22 November 2026 | com.iitsm backend | Explicit members; generated accessors omitted
